shadowSentences: The sun is shining brightly today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Yesterday, I saw a movie that I really liked.
Cooking new recipes is a fun activity for me.
Traveling to new places helps me learn about different cultures.
I often listen to music while I work on my projects.
Exercising regularly has improved my overall health and mood.
Volunteering at local shelters gives me a sense of purpose and connection.
Taking time for hobbies is important for maintaining a balanced life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel destination and why?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of travel in personal growth?
Q4: What tips would you give someone planning their first trip abroad?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical eating routine?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: In your opinion, how does diet influence overall health?
Q4: What advice would you give someone looking to improve their eating habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning styles.
questions: Q1: What is your preferred way of learning new information?
Q2: What challenges do you face with your learning style?
Q3: How do you think learning styles affect academic performance?
Q4: What strategies would you recommend for someone struggling to learn effectively?
